content.comment_body: Hello, I developed a program that sends a message to both devices ([product_name] and [article_no]) during startup (using Flag M8) for 20 seconds. However, after switching the device off and on, the display shows the default menu instead of the programmed one. The hardware version is [version_no]. Please advise, thank you.
In [product_name] software: go to File => Properties (Alt+Enter) => Parameter tab. In the center section, you can choose which display appears after power on. Select Menu.
Are there any other input options?
Hello, You can compress your program into a zip file and upload it, so it can be reviewed. Regards,
This is the program; it works as intended in simulation.

Hello, Within File -> Properties in the Parameter tab, choose Date and Time instead of Menu and it should function correctly. Additionally, if you want to animate text, select the relevant lines in your Message properties. Regards,

analysis.insight_summary: A user is facing a problem where, following a restart, [product_name] Operator Device presents the default menu instead of the custom configured startup screen, despite choosing the desired option in the [product_name] software settings. The solution involves changing the display parameter in settings, which resolves the problem. This highlights some confusion about how different configuration choices in the software impact real device behavior.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the operator device to display their customized startup menu on power-up, consistent with simulated results and specified menu settings.
